thread:
claire: Quick alert — staging canary for MIG-2050 (add event_meta JSONB) hit repeated lock spikes during the backfill. Thinking we pin a mitigated build for the midnight window.
nate: saw the same. lockwatch showed many UPDATEs queued after the ALTER; looks like backfill workers are too aggressive.
sofia: proposal: MIG-2050-hotpin with BACKFILL_BATCH=80, BACKFILL_PARALLEL=1 and an artificial 150ms sleep between batches. No schema changes.
claire: good. rollback triggers: any exclusive lock > 240s OR tourniquet fires twice in 15m -> abort and revert pin.
deploybot: MIG-2050 scheduled 00:00-06:00 UTC. Status: PENDING. Tourniquet rule available. To apply pin, update infra/deploy/configs/migrations.json with pinned_version.
ci-bot: CI for hotpin built: https://ci.internal/mig-2050/hotpin run_id=run-2050-20260329-01 tests: migration-unit, backfill-sim.
sofia: ops checklist:
1) Pause backfill workers on canary hosts: `pkill -USR1 backfill`
2) Deploy MIG-2050-hotpin to 2 canary shards
3) Monitor `lockwatch`, p99 DB latency, and replica lag for 25m
4) If stable, continue phased rollout and keep pin until 05:30 UTC
nate: I'll patch the deploy config and add pinned_version: "MIG-2050-hotpin" and add a short release note: "reduced batch size & serial backfill to avoid lock contention"
claire: also add a temporary tourniquet: pause_on_lock_threshold=3/5m and auto-notify #eng-oncall. If triggered twice, pause and escalate.
deploybot: Tourniquet rule applied for MIG-2050. Will pause rollout and send a page to #eng-oncall when threshold hit.
claire: deploying to canary now. pausing high-concurrency backfill jobs.
sofia: 18m update: canary shows no locks >60s, p99 stable. keeping pin until 05:30 as planned.
nate: attached run_id to release notes and infra tags. follow-up action: expand backfill-sim to include mixed ALTER+UPDATE concurrency.
oncall-bot: note: page policy configured — if deploybot pages, oncall will be paged. Audit tag: run-2050-20260329-01
claire: thanks team — lifting HOLD and proceeding with phased rollout. Closing thread unless regressions.
